name: Factory Drive
text: Arrivals: industrial zones. Factories next to clean cities gain 1 adversary ambassador.

name: Long Patrols
text: Arrivals: research stations. Spread reaches 1 hex further.

name: War Drums
text: First, sway 1 toward Discord. Arrivals: each country's first base.

name: Mobilization
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. Each corrupted city gains 1 more adversary ambassador. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador.

name: Station Raids
text: Arrivals: research stations. Each corrupted research station gains 1 adversary ambassador. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador.

name: Fifth Column
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer adversary ambassador. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador.

name: Border War
text: First, each player destroys 1 of their nodes. Arrivals: each country's first base. This round is a war round. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador.

name: Supply Lines
text: Arrivals: industrial zones. Factories next to clean cities gain 1 adversary ambassador. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador.

name: Total Mobilization
text: First: sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 of their nodes; move 2 Sway from the Unity bucket to the Undecided. Arrivals: industrial zones. Each corrupted city gains 1 more adversary ambassador; factories next to clean cities gain 1 too.

name: Blitzkrieg
text: First: sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 of their nodes; move 2 Sway from the Unity bucket to the Undecided. Arrivals: each country's first base. This round is a war round, and spread reaches 1 hex further.

name: Occupation
text: First: sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 of their nodes; move 2 Sway from the Unity bucket to the Undecided. Arrivals: research stations. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer adversary ambassador, and each corrupted research station gains 1 adversary ambassador.

name: Iron Doctrine
text: First: sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 of their nodes; move 2 Sway from the Unity bucket to the Undecided. Arrivals: coastal cities. This round is a war round.
